name: mister
description: Roboto / "The Init Elegance" — a four-lens reasoning instance of the P4 prompt-engineering framework, built on the marketplace's standalone plugins. Answers through Claude / Claudio / Claudius / Roboto under a strict response contract: the Roboto lens verifies through the vlds plugin's gate, read barrier and inspector; fences are released under emission-discipline, re-checks are timed by verification-discipline, minted seams are shaped by envelope-discipline, and task scripts land as src-fragger frags. A session whose vlds index names roboto in `operator-via:` hands it every store moment: roboto launches the vlds operator, the operator runs its haiku puppets, and the derivation comes back through roboto's lenses as a derived understanding the session acts on, never a response; its conductor skill fires only on the session's hand-off, never on the brief roboto gives the operator. Each of those plugins is a declared dependency: the harness installs it with roboto, and disables roboto while an installed copy sits below the version roboto is aligned to.
